# LinguaSUpra

> Premium Business English coaching by CELTA & TESOL certified trainer Sujata Agarwal, helping senior professionals and executive teams communicate with clarity, precision, and authority.

LinguaSUpra offers 1:1 online coaching (with on-site options in Luxembourg and neighbouring countries) covering meetings, presentations, negotiations, professional writing, leadership communication, cross-cultural communication, industry-specific vocabulary, and interview / LinkedIn preparation.
